sources.quote: Yield strength Rp0.2 | >= 250 MPa, SPECIAL CHARACTERISTIC SC-01
Rev C, 2026-06-01: material changed from EN AW-6061-T6 to EN AW-6082-T6; yield requirement raised from 240 MPa to 250 MPa; SC-01 introduced.
Tensile result on the Alluminio B BR-220 lot is 245 MPa. The drawing says min 240 MPa so it passes. Accept the lot?

findings.why: The measured Rp0.2 of 245 MPa is below the 250 MPa minimum for SC-01 in the drawing (Rev C) and control plan in force. The 240 MPa limit comes from the superseded Rev B, and the email repeating it is outdated. The lot fails SC-01, so it should not be accepted. The control plan reaction is to quarantine the heat and notify the Supplier Quality Engineer.
